note: Same shape as docs/design-systems/free-human/rules.json. First match wins. The design names its semantic layer without a prefix (--bg-page, --gradient-violet); the repo keeps every Wildheart token under --wh-.

tokenDeviations.name: --wh-muted
tokenDeviations.reason: Muted text and the strong border stay #6B5B51 (tokens-v3 accessibility fix): the design's #7D6D62 reads 4.30:1 on parchment and 3.90:1 on aged, under AA for small text; #6B5B51 reads 5.62:1.

tokenDeviations.name: --season
tokenDeviations.reason: The comparison flattens every selector, so the last [data-season] block wins; the repo's own default is var(--color-primary) (the Space accent, violet unless the owner picks one), which is the design's default.

tokenDeviations.name: --gradient-violet-pressed
tokenDeviations.reason: Kept from the tokens-v3 pass (lib/theme/wildheart.ts header): the pressed violet is FLAT, because a pressed gradient read as a second hover.

tokenDeviations.name: --gradient-vellum
tokenDeviations.reason: Kept from the tokens-v3 pass (lib/theme/wildheart.ts header): the vellum gradient runs vellum to the parchment token, so no unnamed hex sits inside a gradient and Nightshade re-points it with one override.

tokenDeviations.name: --gradient-dusk
tokenDeviations.reason: Kept from the tokens-v3 pass (lib/theme/wildheart.ts header): the dusk gradient's middle stop is the blush gradient's light stop, so no unnamed hex sits inside a gradient.
